description: This is a shell script for managing download, cleanup, and path setup of debug tools such as lsof, gperftools, strace, and gdb within a software project. It includes functions for downloading tools, cleaning up, and setting environment variables based on directory existence.

methods.name: clean_debug_tool
methods.description: Cleans all or specific debug tools based on input

methods.name: set_path_variable_lsof
methods.description: Sets PATH environment variable for lsof

methods.name: set_path_variable_gperftools
methods.description: Sets PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and PERL5LIB for gperftools

methods.name: set_all_path_variables
methods.description: Sets environment variables for all debug tools
